title: Fix infinite recursion in Config. Package Field XML name generation
summary: Fixed infinite recursion in XML element name generation when configuration package fields produce duplicate XML names by replacing recursion with a bounded loop that appends counters and properly shortens base names.
key_points: Prevents stack overflow and out-of-memory errors when adding tables to Configuration Packages with field name collisions
Replaces unbounded recursion with bounded loop using counter suffix approach
Ensures suffix always fits within 30-character field name limit by shortening base name first
Maintains backward compatibility for existing packages and correctly resolved names
Added tests verifying behavior with maximum-length field names that previously caused hangs
quote: Adding a table to a Configuration Package could run out of memory or stack while generating package fields.
